heroHeadline: FIFA Council Agrees Governance Review After Zurich Showdown, but Insiders Will Run It
heroSubtitle: After Infantino faced a revolt over the failed World Cup stake sale, the FIFA Council met Oct 15 and agreed a governance review that critics say will be staffed by trusted insiders rather than independent figures. Removal looks unlikely; the March 2027 presidential election remains the next test.
